messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up on the RFC for soft-degrade budgets — thinking about smoothing per-tenant burst consumption across routes. wanted to capture tradeoffs here.
kevin: are we talking per-api-key burst wallets or per-tenant aggregated wallets?
Tess: per-tenant makes billing simpler but loses route-level fairness (eg: embeddings vs chat).
maya: +1 to route-level for fairness, but expensive to track at high cardinality. we can approximate with hot-route caches.
sasha: right. two proposals: (A) per-tenant global burst with weighted route drains; (B) per-route wallets with reservoir refill heuristics.
kevin: option A simpler to implement in admission service. downside: a noisy route can starve low-volume high-value routes.
Tess: Option B needs sharding strategy and evict-on-idle for infrequent routes to avoid O(N) state. Also telemetry complexity.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary 1/3 started for admission-service v2 (will report errors).
darren: small idea — keep global wallet but attach soft priorities per-route (priority multipliers) so we preserve single-state while biasing drains.
maya: that could work. we need clear semantics for multipliers: are they static config or dynamic via ML-ish signals?
sasha: prefer static initial config + signal hook. dynamic ML adjustments later.
kevin: how do we prevent abuse? if multiplier is static, attackers could craft requests on high-multiplier routes. need abuse score integration.
Tess: abuse integration plan: denylist + score-based rent-a-route weights. if abuse_score > X, scale multiplier down and reduce burst cap.
sasha: ok. telemetry: propose a lightweight metric set: tenant_burst_used, tenant_burst_remaining, route_drain_rate, route_multiplier, abuse_score. add histogram for latency impact when soft-shed engages.
maya: +1. also add a tracing tag when we apply soft-shed so we can correlate QoS drops.
sasha: config sketch:
```
soft_degrade:
  mode: global_wallet_with_multipliers
  window_sec: 60
  base_burst_tokens_per_tenant: 1000
  route_multipliers:
    /v1/chat: 1.0
    /v1/embeddings: 0.5
    /v1/re-rank: 0.8
```
kevin: sounds good. we should write a small migration playbook: how to roll from current per-request throttles to this wallet model. canary with small percent of tenants first.
darren: ops checklist: metrics, dashboard, alert on >10% tenants hitting 0 burst within window.
Tess: need clear fallback for dedicated/dedicated-private tenants — some will want to opt out. add config flag allow_opt_out: true/false at tenant level.
sasha: action items: 1) I’ll update RFC with option B appendix and the multiplier proposal. 2) maya + kevin to prototype admission-hook + telemetry. 3) ops to draft canary playbook.
kevin: pinging @maya via DM to sync on proto infra.
Tess: noted. thanks. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INFRA-4821 to track canary rollout tasks.
note: short thread, RFC follow-up about budget smoothing and abuse integration
